description: Firmware updates over the network (MQTT.md, Firmware updates). The master stores images and sends update; the logger downloads it over HTTP from the master, checks size and SHA-256, writes it to its spare app slot and reboots into it. The new firmware must become healthy (sensors OK, connected to the master) within confirm_timeout_s, or the logger switches back to the previous firmware. Refused while recording.

confirm_timeout_s.description: How long new firmware has to become healthy before the logger rolls back to the previous firmware.

state.description: failed: the last download or check failed; the old firmware kept running (see last_error).

target_version.description: Version being installed, while updating or confirming.

previous_version.description: Version that ran before the last update.

confirm_s.description: Seconds left for new firmware to become healthy, while confirming.

last_error.description: Why the last update failed or was rolled back.

update.description: Download and install firmware. Acks at once ({ accepted: true }); progress follows in status and events. busy while recording or while an update is running; invalid_args if arguments are missing or wrong, the model isn't this logger's, or the image is too big for the slot.

path.description: Path on the master's HTTP server, e.g. /firmware/VL-P1/0.4.0.bin. Fetched from the host this logger reached the MQTT broker at.

url.description: Full URL instead of path and port (optional).

events.update_failed: Download or check failed; the old firmware keeps running and nothing changed. Detail: version, error.
events.update_installed: New firmware became healthy after the reboot and is now permanent. Detail: version, previous_version.
events.update_rolled_back: New firmware didn't become healthy in time (or kept crashing), so the logger switched back to the previous firmware and rebooted. Detail: version, previous_version, reason.
